theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < n → IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h U → (∀ y ∈ U, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → ∀ (x : Euclid n) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → closedBall x r ⊆ U → (∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∫ y : Euclid n, h (x - y) * g (‖y‖ ^ 2) = h x * ∫ y : Euclid n, g (‖y‖ ^ 2)) ∧ ∫ y in ball x r, h y = (volume (ball x r)).toReal * h x
